mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goal(member_id, goal_type, title, target_value, target_date) VALUES(#{memberId}, #{goalType}, #{title}, #{targetValue}, #{targetDate})
mapper.select: SELECT goal_id, member_id, goal_type, title, target_value, target_date, create_at FROM goal WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND (target_date IS NULL OR target_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY)) ORDER BY (target_date IS NULL), target_date ASC, create_at DESC

SELECT goal_id, member_id, goal_type, title, target_value, target_date, create_at FROM goal WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND target_date IS NOT NULL AND target_date < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) ORDER BY target_date DESC
